title: "02 · Your first plot"
output: html_notebook
---

> **Question:** what does our experiment look like — how many samples per lifestyle?

Learn the grammar of graphics by building a bar chart: **data → aesthetics → geom → layers**.

## Setup — run this first

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
data_dir <- if (dir.exists("data")) "data" else if (dir.exists("../data")) "../data" else "project/data"
meta <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## data → aesthetics → geom

```{r}
ggplot(meta, aes(x = lifestyle)) +   # data + aesthetic
  geom_bar()                         # geom
```

## Add a layer: another aesthetic

```{r}
ggplot(meta, aes(x = lifestyle, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_bar()
```

## Add labels

```{r}
ggplot(meta, aes(x = lifestyle, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Our experiment", x = NULL, y = "Number of samples", fill = "Timepoint")
```
